ja356:1.1: Eko araññe girikandarāya paggayha paggayha silaṃ pavecchasi punappunaṃ santaramānarūpo, Kāraṇḍiya ko nu tava idh' attho ti.
ja356:2.1: Ahaṃ h' imaṃ sāgarasevitantaṃ samaṃ karissāmi yathāpi pāṇiṃ vikiriya sānūni ca pabbatāni ca, tasmā silaṃ dariyā pakkhipāmīti.
ja356:3.1: Na imaṃ mahiṃ arahati pāṇikappaṃ samaṃ manusso karaṇāya-m-eko, maññām': imañ ñeva dariṃ jigiṃsaṃ Kārandiya hāhasi jīvalokan ti.
ja356:4.1: Sace ayam bhūtadharaṃ na sattho samaṃ manusso karaṇāya-m-eko evam eva tvaṃ brahme ime manusse nānādiṭṭhike nānāyissasi te ti.
ja356:5.1: Saṃkhittarūpena bhavaṃ mam' atthaṃ akkhāsi Kāraṇḍiya evam etaṃ: yathā na sakkā paṭhavī samāyaṃ kātuṃ manussena tathā manussā ti.
